**ARC-AGI-3 | Late launch preview — October 7**

A five-member team now called 復活の混テキスト tore through the public field: 170th to seventh, 30.51 to 38.15, between mtg and artificialagencylab.com. The top two held station: Tufa Labs first at 55.89 and Yi-Chia Chen second at 48.59. Majkel1337 stands third at 42.66.

_hans also climbed from 40th to 15th, while NVARC3 and Lord Han Solo sit ninth and tenth on unchanged scores across the comparison points. The provisional public gold line rose from 34.30 to 34.74. Final medals depend on the private board.

Standings recorded at 11:42 pm Eastern; it is not the scheduled 6 pm edition. [Read the full report](https://arc.markbarney.net/news/2026-10-07-evening-arc-3-preview)
headline: A charge from 170th to seventh jolts the ARC-AGI-3 chase

sections.heading: The break into seventh
sections.text: The team now listed as 復活の混テキスト delivered the clearest verified swing in this launch preview. At the previous comparison snapshot it was 170th with 30.51. At the late October 7 snapshot it stood seventh with 38.15: a gain of 163 places and 7.64 points. The team ID stayed the same even though its display name changed. The move puts it between sixth-place mtg at 38.33 and eighth-place artificialagencylab.com at 37.94.

sections.heading: The leaders and the crowded gold line
sections.text: Tufa Labs remains first at 55.89, and Yi-Chia Chen second at 48.59. Majkel1337 is third at 42.66, although the available history does not establish its full movement over the comparison period. The last dance 🕺 is fourth at 39.30. NVARC3 sits ninth at 37.51 and Lord Han Solo tenth at 36.61; each kept the same score across the available comparison points while its rank slipped two places. The provisional public gold cutoff moved from 34.30 to 34.74. Final results will be decided on the private leaderboard.

sections.heading: Movement through the field
sections.text: _hans rose from 40th to 15th as its score went from 33.00 to 35.69. Rachid Caich climbed from 171st to 40th, and Nithin Kumar R C from 280th to 44th. David Hartmann stayed on 29.83 while moving from 246th to 288th as the field reshuffled. Jan Disselhoff is 508th at 28.23 in the closing snapshot; the available historical coverage does not support a day comparison for that entry. This is a manual launch preview using standings recorded at 11:42 pm Eastern, not the scheduled 6 pm edition.
